_comment: Vault fields that hold a GitHub token a workload reads. bin/idp-github-app refresh re-mints each one as an installation token of the estate-agents App narrowed to the named lane (lanes.json), hourly from bin/idp-verify-drill; the ExternalSecret that renders it refreshes every 15 minutes. No PAT is ever pasted (crew#66 root trust, crew#577).
